newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Uneximbank says Norilsk tender on Tues.
newsitem.headline: Uneximbank says Norilsk tender on Tues.

text.p: A tender for 38 percent of Russia's biggest metals company Norilsk Nickel, which had been challenged by the government, will go ahead on Tuesday as planned, said Uneximbank, which currently holds the stake.
"Yes, the results of the tender will be known today. The results will be known at five o'clock (1300 GMT)," said Uneximbank spokesman Modest Kolerov.
Uneximbank is widely tipped to win the auction for the stake, which represents 51 percent of Norilsk voting shares.
On Monday Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin ordered the organisers of the tender to suspend it, and privatisation minister Alfred Kokh on Tuesday also called for a delay.
But officials at Uneximbank and its affiliates organising the auction said it would go ahead.
